Messages.Author: Patrick Drapeau
Messages.Body:
In article <4t8gdd$3...@rouge.usl.edu>, <gu...@csr03.usl.edu> wrote:

> I was wondering, if I give Spiridonas the Ankara Citadel, would he be
> able to use his ability (x+2 blood for +x bleed) at half the cost?
> Thanks.

Read it carefully: "pays only half of the blood ost for any CARDS he or
she PLAYS" I mat not be a born english speaker, but this is present tense.
And a vampire is not considered a card, even less his special abilities.

Patrick Drapeau

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
